name: John F. Kennedy International Airport

runway.v: four runways; the longest, 13R/31L, is 14,511 ft x 200 ft (about 4,423 m)

hours.quote: 2.3.1 All Months, All Days, All Hours

slots.v: IATA Level 3 slot-controlled airport; FAA limits scheduled operations by an Order that runs to 28 Oct 2028; designated hours 06:00-23:00 local (10:00-03:00 UTC in summer time)
slots.quote: FAA has designated JFK as an IATA Level 3 airport consistent with the Worldwide Slot Guideline (WSG).

ppr.v: special air traffic rule (14 CFR Part 93) for a high-density airport: a prior reservation is required
ppr.quote: SPECIAL AIR TFC RULES-PART 93 HIGH DENSITY ARPT. PROR RESERVATION REQUIRED.

noise.v: Port Authority departure noise limit of 112 PNdB, measured at community monitors, with a USD 250 charge per violating departure at JFK; aeroplanes certificated over 75,000 lb must meet Stage 3, and types certificated after 1 Jan 2006 Stage 4
noise.quote: Noise produced by a departing aircraft shall not exceed 112 PNdB
